en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large historic town hall building with a steep tiled roof, ornate gables, clock and tower with a weather vane. The facade has arched entrances at street level and several windows; a sign reading "Stadtkeller" is visible on the right side, above an awning. Small figures and a bicycle stand in the square in front of the building. Printed text at the top left reads "Lommatzsch i. Sa. Rathaus."
